repos.name: fleetd
repos.description: Pellam dispatch back end (fleetd server, simctl)

repos.name: queue
repos.description: Generic ring queue for Go (open source, vendored by fleetd)

issues.title: simkit: set up the 0.4.0 release
issues.body:
Splits simkit out of the fleetd module so Sim Tools can version it on its own cadence.

- Adds tools/simkit/go.mod (`module git.pellam.io/fleetd/tools/simkit`). From this PR on, tools/simkit is a separate module that happens to live in this repository; it is no longer part of the fleetd module.
- Tags tools/simkit/v0.4.0.
- fleetd's go.mod now requires it like any other dependency: `require git.pellam.io/fleetd/tools/simkit v0.4.0`.
- `go mod vendor` copies it to vendor/git.pellam.io/fleetd/tools/simkit, and vendor/modules.txt lists it. Release builds (-mod=vendor) compile that vendored copy, not tools/simkit on main.

Diff summary:
```
 go.mod                                            | +2
 tools/simkit/go.mod                               | +3 (new)
 vendor/modules.txt                                | +3
 vendor/git.pellam.io/fleetd/tools/simkit/*.go     | +1,204 (new)
```
Reviewed by Platform Foundations (Ruth) and Sim Tools (Mato).

issues.title: simkit 0.4.2: wheel tick default
issues.body: go get git.pellam.io/fleetd/tools/simkit@v0.4.2 && go mod vendor. Picks up the wheel tick default. 0.5.0 (Reset-after-Stop no-op, Window clamp) is not tagged yet.

issues.title: CODEOWNERS: internal/dispatch/lease/ to Fleet Reliability
issues.body: Action 3 of the 7 Oct lease review. Adds `/internal/dispatch/lease/ @pellam/fleet-reliability` after the dispatch rules; last match decides, so lease files leave Dispatch Core.

issues.title: CODEOWNERS: queue/ (any depth) to Messaging
issues.body: From the settlement queue ownership review. `queue/` without a leading slash, placed after the product-area rules.

issues.title: CODEOWNERS: telemetry exporter hand-over to Platform
issues.body: Ingest hands the exporter to Platform. Rather than delete Ingest's narrow line, this appends `/internal/telemetry/ @pellam/platform` after it; as the later rule it covers the exporter too. The narrow line stays until Ingest's open exporter PRs are closed.

issues.title: CODEOWNERS: retry/ (any depth) to Fleet Reliability
issues.body: Retry and backoff helpers anywhere in the tree are Fleet Reliability's.

issues.title: simkit: Reset after Stop is a no-op; Window clamps to capacity
issues.body: Changes tools/simkit on main only (heading for simkit 0.5.0). fleetd keeps the vendored 0.4.2 until the bump PR (SIM-618).

issues.title: lease: renewer must not re-arm after Stop
issues.body: Fixes the re-arm-after-Stop panic in internal/dispatch/lease/renewer.go (REL-233). Guards rearm with the renewer's own stopped flag.

issues.title: telemetry: grow encoder buffer before slicing
issues.body: Fixes the frame overflow panic in internal/telemetry/exporter/encode.go.

issues.title: simctl replay panics at end of recorded day
issues.body: Cursor.Step peeks one past the end on a trailing pickup. Seen in FLEETD-4ZD.

issues.title: Digest scheduler uses zero-value simkit.Wheel
issues.body: NewScheduler never calls simkit.NewWheel. Messaging to fix in internal/notify/digest.

issues.title: Quote page panics when no carrier declined
issues.body: explain() calls s.last.Error() on a nil *DeclineError.
